# ScoreUp Pro

> AI-powered exam preparation platform for IELTS, Goethe-Zertifikat (A1–C2), and telc Deutsch (A1–C2).
> Real practice tests, instant AI grading, personalized study plans, and vocabulary training.

## Exams

- [IELTS Academic](https://scoreup.pro/exams/ielts-academic): For university admissions, 0–9 band score across Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking.
- [IELTS General Training](https://scoreup.pro/exams/ielts-general): For immigration and work, 0–9 band score across all four skills.
- [Goethe-Zertifikat A1](https://scoreup.pro/exams/goethe-a1): Beginner German, CEFR A1, typically for Germany family reunion visas.
- [Goethe-Zertifikat A2](https://scoreup.pro/exams/goethe-a2): Elementary German, CEFR A2.
- [Goethe-Zertifikat B1](https://scoreup.pro/exams/goethe-b1): Independent German, CEFR B1, required for German citizenship.
- [Goethe-Zertifikat B2](https://scoreup.pro/exams/goethe-b2): Upper-intermediate German, CEFR B2, common for university entry.
- [Goethe-Zertifikat C1](https://scoreup.pro/exams/goethe-c1): Advanced German, CEFR C1.
- [Goethe-Zertifikat C2](https://scoreup.pro/exams/goethe-c2): Mastery, CEFR C2, Großes Deutsches Sprachdiplom.

## telc Deutsch-Prüfung Mock Exams

Free AI-graded telc Deutsch-Prüfung mock exams across all 6 CEFR levels. telc Deutsch is one of the two major German-language certifications (alongside Goethe-Zertifikat); B1+B2 levels include the unique Sprachbausteine grammar/vocab subtest, C1 has Pflichtaufgabe + Wahlaufgabe writing structure, C2 fuses Hörverstehen with Schreiben into a single subtest. Each landing page documents that level's structure, scoring, sample questions per Teil, and links to a free AI-graded mock exam.

- [telc A1 Deutsch-Prüfung](https://scoreup.pro/resources/telc-a1-deutsch-pruefung): Beginner level (CEFR A1), Lesen + Hören + Schreiben, joint Goethe Start Deutsch 1 format.
- [telc A2 Deutsch-Prüfung](https://scoreup.pro/resources/telc-a2-deutsch-pruefung): Elementary user, 3 stacks like A1 but with Anzeigen-Zuordnung and Kurze Mitteilung writing.
- [telc B1 Deutsch-Prüfung](https://scoreup.pro/resources/telc-b1-deutsch-pruefung): Independent user threshold; Lesen + Sprachbausteine + Hören + Schreiben. Same exam as the legacy "Zertifikat Deutsch B1". Accepted for German naturalisation.
- [telc B2 Deutsch-Prüfung](https://scoreup.pro/resources/telc-b2-deutsch-pruefung): Independent user (advanced); same 4 stacks as B1, with Konjunktiv II and academic register. Common university-entry threshold.
- [telc C1 Deutsch-Prüfung](https://scoreup.pro/resources/telc-c1-deutsch-pruefung): Proficient user; Lesen with sub-numbered Teile + Hören (Vortrag/Diskussion) + Schreiben with Pflichtaufgabe and Wahlaufgabe. telc C1 Hochschule variant exists for university admission.
- [telc C2 Deutsch-Prüfung](https://scoreup.pro/resources/telc-c2-deutsch-pruefung): Mastery (near-native); only 2 stacks — Lesen + fused Hörverstehen+Schreiben single subtest. Compares to Goethe Großes Deutsches Sprachdiplom (GDS).

All telc landing pages are localized into 9 languages (en/de/tr/es/ru/uk/ar/hi/zh) with full hreflang cluster. Locked German terminology — TELC, Sprachbausteine, Pflichtaufgabe, Wahlaufgabe, Hörverstehen+Schreiben, Teil — is preserved verbatim across every locale.

## Free Tools

- [Leben in Deutschland Test (Free Mock)](https://scoreup.pro/practice/leben-in-deutschland): Free practice for the official German citizenship test (Einbürgerungstest). 33-question mock with 60-minute timer, 17/33 to pass, all 460 official BAMF questions including state-specific ones. Page also explains the Einbürgerungstest format, cost (€25 in 2026), eligibility, and preparation steps. Free, ad-free, unlimited.

The Leben in Deutschland test (also called Einbürgerungstest) is the official BAMF civic-knowledge exam required for German citizenship through naturalisation. The catalog has 460 questions: 300 general + 16 × 10 state-specific. The real exam draws 33 questions (30 general + 3 from the candidate's chosen Bundesland), 60 minutes, 17/33 to pass. The exam is distinct from but typically taken alongside Goethe-Zertifikat B1 (the language requirement for citizenship).

## About

ScoreUp Pro is operated from Germany. Practice tests are AI-generated and AI-graded.
ScoreUp Pro is not affiliated with official IELTS or Goethe-Institut examination bodies; scores are estimates for practice purposes.
